name: discoverandchange/oe-module-dc-assessments
comment-require: Symfony is pinned to the SAME major OpenEMR 8.4.1 core ships (7.4) so the module's bundled copies stay ABI-compatible with core's in-process. The explicit caps on http-foundation/string/console/type-info/var-exporter stop transitive drift onto Symfony 8, which would collide fatally with core. (Doctrine was dropped entirely — the module uses OpenEMR QueryUtils/raw SQL, not Doctrine.)

scripts.phpstan: MODULE_DIR=$(pwd) && cd ${MODULE_DIR}/../../../.. && php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/phpstan analyze --configuration=phpstan.neon.dist ${MODULE_DIR}/src
scripts.rector-check: MODULE_DIR=$(pwd) && cd ${MODULE_DIR}/../../../.. && php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run ${MODULE_DIR}/src
scripts.rector-fix: MODULE_DIR=$(pwd) && cd ${MODULE_DIR}/../../../.. && php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/rector process ${MODULE_DIR}/src
